exposure: same position of fetus during last two months of pregnancy
cohort: The study included 62 children aged 6-8 years with deciduous or mixed dentition: 31 with malocclusion (test group) and 31 controls.
finding: The study found that prolonged use of beta tocolytics during pregnancy was strongly associated with childhood malocclusion risk.
mod_finding: The study found no association between breastfeeding and childhood malocclusion risk, and that caesarean delivery seemed to be slightly protective against malocclusion risk.
